title: uallak slide design spec v1
description: The media agent's design surface for text slides. The agent writes THIS JSON; core/slide_renderer draws it with real fonts (Pillow + raqm). The agent never writes rendering code. Coordinates are RTL-native: x_pct is measured from the RIGHT margin inward. Colours are ROLES resolved against the client's palette variant, never hex. Text may use the placeholders {headline}, {body}, {n} and {total}; a block whose text resolves to empty is not drawn. A headline/body block with no text gets {headline}/{body}. The renderer FAILS (never clips or shrinks) when a block overflows its box, blocks overlap, a headline has too many words, or text contrast against what is under it is below the legibility threshold (WCAG ratio 4.5, or 3.0 for large text: size >= 40, or size >= 32 at weight >= 700).

name.description: A short label for this design.

palette_variant.description: Set by the SYSTEM from the brand brief and the post's audience. Never chosen or changed by the agent; a set never mixes variants.

margins.description: Safe area in px: one number for all sides, or per side.

role_overrides.description: Per slide role (from the post's brief), replaces these top-level keys for slides of that role, e.g. a different hook slide.

color_role.description: solid; the first part of split/gradient. Default bg.

second_color_role.description: split: the second part; gradient: where it ends.

image_asset_id.description: image: a Drive file id of the CLIENT'S OWN photo (account_state.media_folder.images). Never a generated image of text.

scrim_opacity.description: image: a colour wash over the photo for legibility.

scrim_color_role.description: image: the wash colour. Default bg.

split_ratio.description: split: share of the first part.

split_direction.description: horizontal = top/bottom parts; vertical = right/left parts (the first part on the right).

anchor.description: Which edge of the box sits at y_pct.

align.description: Default right. Hebrew is never left-aligned.

x_pct.description: Box's right edge, % of canvas width, measured from the right margin inward. Default 0.

max_height_pct.description: Box height, % of canvas height. Default: whatever fits inside the margins.

font_family.description: Rubik for headlines, Assistant for body (bundled; per-client families later).

position.description: bar: an edge; number_badge / corner_mark: a corner; underline: under_headline.

size.description: px: bar/underline thickness, badge diameter, corner arm length.

asset_ref.description: A Drive file id of the client's logo (PNG with transparency) in their media folder.
